# tomswallapi_routing_rule (Resource)

Directs traffic to a provider's routing table on a device (rtrules).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_routing_rule" "office_via_isp1" {
  device           = "fw1"
  source           = "198.51.100.0/24"
  routing_provider = "isp1"
  priority         = 1000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) Owning device.
- `routing_provider` (String) Provider whose routing table matching traffic uses.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `dest` (String) Destination address or network to match.
- `mark` (String) Firewall mark to match.
- `persistent` (Boolean) Keep the entry in place while the firewall is stopped.
- `priority` (Number) Routing rule priority; lower first.
- `source` (String) Source address, network, or interface to match.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_routing_rule.office_via_isp1 42
```
